Dingtong Technology.evidence: Dingtong Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026): communications connector cage (CAGE) revenue rose 77.86% on strong AI-driven demand; the company's main customers are connector makers Amphenol, Molex, TE Connectivity, AVIC Jonhon and Luxshare; 112G products were in strong demand and the 224G series reached mass production in 2025.

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology annual report: 2025 Annual Report (03-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report, 2026 business plan (company): in communications, push scaled mass production of 224Gbps products, speed up R&D and sampling of 448Gbps products and break through on liquid-cooled I/O connectors for AI servers and computing centers; deepen cooperation with existing core customers Amphenol, Molex, TE Connectivity, AVIC Jonhon and Luxshare to win more high-speed and liquid-cooled orders, and approach leading domestic computing centers and AI-server makers directly; add high-speed production lines in China and shift part of communications production to Malaysia, where capacity is to be expanded. In automotive, focus on high-voltage, electronic-control and BMS connectors and products for 800V platforms.
